name: SK hynix M17
summary: A NAND flash fab SK hynix plans at its Cheongju campus, which already houses the M11, M12 and M15 fabs. In its July 2026 plan for the Chungcheong region the company earmarked about KRW 80 trillion for M17, with construction from 2027 and operations in the first half of 2029. In August 2026 the board approved KRW 19.1 trillion for M17 through April 2031, with groundbreaking in February 2027 and the first cleanroom opening in December 2028. SK hynix's Korean release gives M17 a gross floor area of about 206,000 pyeong, which its English release renders as a total area of about 680,000 m²; this is neither a site nor a cleanroom area, so it is not recorded as a figure.

metrics.note: Amount assigned to M17 in the July 2026 Chungcheong investment plan.

milestones.note: Operations targeted for the first half of 2029.
